label: letter u in memory: around the step u is copied out, and late original steps when u began the sequence
explanation: A u-specific feature. During the delimiter and copy phases it ramps up over the 2 steps before the model outputs an original u, peaks on the step that outputs u (out_tok==u is active 96% of the time), and stays on for one more step, where u comes back in as input. After the last u has been output it dies off quickly. The strongest activations are on sequences that start with u u u, at the first copied u. In the original phase it fires weakly to moderately from t>=3 when u was one of the first two tokens; it is completely silent at t=0-1. It does not fire on copy steps far from any u, and is mostly quiet in sequences with no u. Magnitude is largest at u outputs and grows with repeated u. The predicate misses a weak, diffuse tail of low activations (about 12% of mass) on sequences without u, and some steps three or more outputs before a u. Dev F1 is 0.76 and mass recall 0.88.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=u (+11.88), out_tok=u (+9.30), next_out=u (+5.76), orig0=u (+4.88), orig1=u (+3.85), orig2=u (+2.55). Lower it: phase=2 & in_tok=l (-11.34), out_tok=l (-8.63), prev2_tok=- (-6.63), out_tok=a (-6.30).
